behaviors.description: Package-relative path to the character's behavior set.

id.description: Instance name used by interactions and the episode script.

role.description: creature = full species package; prop = lightweight participant driven by interaction definitions (v2 target: extract the heron's fish into this class).

episode_script.description: Optional deterministic episode (the v1 preview pattern): an ordered list of segments for previews and QA. Real-time play uses the behavior policy instead; both consume the same corpus + effects runtime.

presence.description: External mode in force during this segment.

at_frame.description: Absolute start frame (parallel tracks); omit for sequential-after-this-character's-last-segment.

inputs.description: The external event bus. Derived modes (watched/empty/night) are computed from raw inputs by these rules; behavior pacing keys off modes. Generalizes presence_interface.json.

enter.description: Condition expression over inputs, e.g. 'presence == 0 for 120s'.

priority.description: Higher wins when several modes match.

derived_modes.description: Named external modes. Exactly one is 'default'.

source.description: Hardware binding description (firmware-side); the engine only needs the semantics.

raw.description: Raw inputs: presence (mmWave), ambient_light (lux), button, clock.

interactions.description: MULTI-CHARACTER INTERACTIONS as data: who, what triggers it, and the weighted joint outcomes. Heron<->fish (predator/prey) is instance #1.

between.description: Participant instance ids, in role order matching 'roles'. Participants are usually characters; an OBJECT instance may also take part (its outcomes use set_state instead of clip_kind/behavior).

outcomes.description: Weighted outcomes; each names what each participant plays and any shared effect events spawned (with the environment effect_map resolving them).

play.description: Map of character instance id -> what that participant performs.

set_state.description: For OBJECT participants only: state overrides applied to the placed instance (e.g. {lamp: 1}). An object never plays a clip or a behavior; an interaction changes its state and its rig re-renders from it.

roles.description: Semantic roles, e.g. [predator, prey] or [greeter, greeted].

kind.description: proximity: characters within range; event: a named bus/clip event fires; schedule: pacing-driven chance per minute.

objects.description: OBJECT instances placed in the scene (landmarks, structures, vegetation, vessels — the non-living cast). An object is drawn by its own package rig from state, never trained, never behavior-driven; creatures reach it through its declared affordances/anchors. Placement: exactly one of 'zone' (an environment zone name) or explicit design coords x/y; 'layer' composites it behind (back, default) or in front of (front) the creature tracks. 'state' overrides the package's state defaults for this placement (e.g. lamp: 1 at night).

id.description: Instance name used by interactions and affordance lookups.

state.description: State overrides merged over the package defaults.

zone.description: Environment zone to stand in (its x, and y if the zone declares one).
